# Security

For a vulnerability in a particular project, follow its own security policy. This repository contains the organisation profile and shared guidance.

Do not publish credentials, private data or an exploitable vulnerability in an issue. If the affected repository offers private vulnerability reporting, use its Security tab. Otherwise contact j.d.a.jewell@open.ac.uk with the repository name and a concise description; agree a suitable channel before sending sensitive material.

Response times are not guaranteed. Public issues are appropriate for ordinary broken links and documentation corrections that do not expose a vulnerability.
